scope: Only normal main Ted processes launched through the existing fresh_ted.Driver.start lifecycle. The setting is an inline process flag, not a global or project settings file.
scope_limit: Accepts all authenticated local peer messages into that one main process. It is not a voice-sender allowlist. Isolated test launches receive no override.
activation: Requires the next normal Fresh Ted lifecycle after explicit approval. The patch does not update or restart the currently running main process.
rollback: Remove only the added conditional --settings argument pair from Driver.start. A receiver already started with the override retains it until its normal lifecycle ends.
approval_reason: BRIEF.md explicitly says not to change Claude settings. This proposal is prepared for explicit approval of that exception.
validation_method: Compile the original and proposed Driver methods in memory, capture their local cli boundary before any launch, and compare all four main/test and start/resume combinations.
